My coworker and his girlfriend went down to Cozumel to do their open water dives for their certification. Everything went fine. She took 3 days off from her last dive until her flight back. On the flight back, she got sick with the bends and had to stop in San Francisco. 3 days later and what would have been a $110,000 bill later, she's fine. Luckily she had DAN insurance and didn't have to pay anything.

Even though she took 3 days instead of the minimum 1 day, she still got sick. Don't think it can't happen to you just because you follow the guidelines.
